scale_cues: Square white dinner plate assumed about 26-27 cm wide, filling most of the frame; corn cob round (about 4-5 cm diameter) used as a secondary size reference.
assumptions: Protein is taken to be breaded chicken breast; it could be breaded fish or pork, as the image is low resolution.
Leafy greens assumed to be spinach or kale, wilted with a small amount of oil.
Small grains on the greens assumed to be quinoa; could be breadcrumbs or another grain.
Dark pieces in the greens and beneath the chicken assumed to be mushrooms.
Orange-red piece assumed to be roasted carrot; could be roasted red pepper or sweet potato.
Corn mass counts kernels only, excluding the cob.
Oil quantity is inferred from the preparation, not seen.
Scattered crumbs on the plate are ignored as negligible.
